name: claude-superpack
description: An engineering operating system for Claude Code: risk-tiered workflows, on-demand domain references, deterministic scripts, and an evidence gate before any completion claim.

interface.shortDescription: Size the work, load only the knowledge it needs, prove the result with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Nine skills and fifteen domain references that add engineering judgement to Claude Code without adding context bloat. The core skill sizes every task on two axes — scope (how much work) and risk (what happens if it is wrong) — and runs the lightest workflow that is safe for that combination: no ceremony on a typo, a rollback plan and explicit confirmation before a schema migration. Domain depth for frontend, backend, data, AI/LLM, cloud, DevOps, SRE, security, performance, testing, architecture, quality and documentation lives in references that are read only when a task actually touches them, so breadth costs nothing until it is used. Four bundled zero-dependency scripts replace guesswork with deterministic output: stack and convention detection, verification gates distilled to pass/fail plus the real errors, git-diff risk and blast-radius analysis, and a high-precision secret scan. A verification skill gates every completion claim behind evidence produced after the change. The pack defers to first-party tools where they exist — code review, security review, simplify, frontend design — rather than duplicating them. Always-on cost is about 750 tokens per turn; a three-tier benchmark suite in the repository measures structure, routing and behaviour.
